policy: Every raw field read against public request and bound facts. Accept understandable factual captions with original metadata even outside finite grammar; reject malformed displayed prices, incoherent use attribution and unsupported recommendations. Ambiguous lunch-box kitchen-table recommendation is a separate pending-verification judgment.
limitations: No validator/benchmark/output edits, repairs, GPU/model execution or new formal acceptance rule.
Six inspected development-replay requests; posthoc target retrieval is a public-function proxy, not exhaustive relevance or human usefulness.
Full endpoint timers exclude browser paint and image transfer; contextual usability is retrospective, not a new runtime-validated latency measurement.
First-three target retrieval and individual useful target-card copy remain separate from whole-payload usability.
